lines.en: My tail feathers brush through the ferns.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，一步步前移
lines.en: Crouched low, I creep forward

lines.zh: 尾羽平衡着每一次转向
lines.en: My tail feathers balance each turn

lines.zh: 三个人一起走才叫队形
lines.en: Three of us moving is a formation
My toe claws grip the ground
Quiet now, quieter still
Every step measures the distance
We curve into a half circle
This brush is taller than me, perfect
Heels lifted, ready to spring

lines.zh: 昨天那只猎物还在这儿
lines.en: Yesterday's prey was right here

lines.zh: 我的爪印连着同族的爪印
lines.en: My prints run alongside my pack's
Before closing in, I check the wind
The softer I walk, the cleaner the bite

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，等一个信号
lines.en: I crouch low and wait for a signal

lines.zh: 头一歪，听林子里的动静
lines.en: Head cocked, I listen to the wood
My claws rake the dirt without thinking
I am still, but I am calculating

lines.zh: 三双眼睛，一起看着前面
lines.en: Three pairs of eyes, all facing forward
There is a trace of blood on the wind
I open my jaws to cool down, quietly

lines.zh: 这片领地我们守了很久
lines.en: We have held this ground a long time
Whoever bolts first gets bitten first
My crest feathers rise a little
I lick my own pointed teeth

lines.zh: 腿肌绷着，随时能弹出去
lines.en: My leg muscles coil, ready to snap out
We need no calls between us

lines.zh: 耐心是猎人唯一的规矩
lines.en: Patience is a hunter's only rule
Anyone behind you, no

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔跟着你的手转。
lines.en: My pupils track the movement of your hand.

lines.zh: 你太快转身，反而露了空
lines.en: Turn too fast and you leave a gap

lines.zh: 三个方向，你只看得见一个
lines.en: Three angles, and you see only one
Do not raise your hands

lines.zh: 你的气味很新，我记住了
lines.en: Your scent is new, and I remember it
We have you in the middle
Look up and look at me
You blinked once, and I saw it
I am not the only one watching
That instant of hesitation is enough
You are thinking of running, right
I tilt my head as if hearing your heart
Hold still, let me see your hands
I see fear in your eyes, good
I am only waiting for you to move first
I shriek and pull back
That one landed on me
Blood seeps from the base of my feathers
I spring away and twist my ankle
It hurts, but we do not scatter
My packmate glances at me

lines.zh: 我低伏下去，重新算距离
lines.en: I drop low and re-measure the distance
You are tougher than you look
This wound will last a while

lines.zh: 我发出一声短促的嘶鸣
lines.en: I let out a short, sharp hiss
We can share that piece of meat
Drop it and go, do not look back

lines.zh: 我们也吃腐肉，但更喜欢新
lines.en: We eat carrion, but prefer it fresh

lines.zh: 你的手伸得太远了一点
lines.en: Your hand reaches a little too far

lines.zh: 香味压不住我们的饥饿
lines.en: The smell cannot cover our hunger
Do not feed three mouths with one piece

lines.zh: 我闻到了，同族也闻到了
lines.en: I smell it, and so do my pack
My claws hook and hold.
Your bait is too obvious

lines.zh: 我们收下了，谢谢你的腿
lines.en: We accept it, and your legs too

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴了，羽毛都竖了。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; my feathers bristle.

lines.zh: 爪子在你腿上刮了一下
lines.en: A claw grazes your leg

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁也没倒
lines.en: We collide, and neither falls
This close, you have nerve
Step aside, do not block me
I spring back half a step and re-aim
Bone on bone, a sharp sound

lines.zh: 我几乎是擦着你过去的
lines.en: I passed within a hair of you

lines.zh: 这一下不算攻击，只是路过
lines.en: That was not an attack, just passing
Crowd me again and I bite

lines.zh: 我们低下身子互相绕圈
lines.en: We circle each other, crouched low

lines.zh: 羽毛竖起，嗓子发出低鸣
lines.en: Feathers up, a low rasp in my throat
Paired up, our hunting gets sharper

lines.zh: 三只里只有一只愿意回应我
lines.en: Only one of the three answers me
Our calls are light, almost birdlike

lines.zh: 同一片林子能养两张嘴
lines.en: This wood can feed two mouths
We touch foreheads first
A mate is also a partner
We guard this nest together

lines.zh: 谁抓到大猎物，就分给谁
lines.en: Whoever takes the big kill shares it
I snatch this meat and run
We pass the prize mouth to mouth
I tuck it under the roots
Keep this, we eat later

lines.zh: 你掉了东西，我们收下了
lines.en: You dropped something, we took it
Quick, into my jaws, the pack is here
Small as it is, it fills a tooth gap
I pin it down with a foreclaw
This does not belong here
Pick it up, then look around again

lines.zh: 爪子搭上肩，你已经输了。
lines.en: Claws on your shoulder. You are done.
I have your throat in view

lines.zh: 从这一秒起，你被算进猎物
lines.en: From this second, you are prey
The formation opens, and you are surrounded

lines.zh: 我压低身子，盯住那个背影
lines.en: I crouch and lock on that back

lines.zh: 我的爪子落地，几乎没有声音。
lines.en: My claws touch down almost silently.

lines.zh: 风向正好，你闻不到我们
lines.en: The wind is right, you cannot smell us
One target, three angles
Your knee is shaking

lines.zh: 我选定你了，最外圈的那个
lines.en: I pick you, the one on the outside
One more heartbeat, and I move

lines.zh: 刚才那声响，是我们故意的
lines.en: That noise just now, we made it on purpose

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就得到了答案
lines.en: You turned, and I got my answer
Run now, and it gets interesting

lines.zh: 我贴着地追，你听得见爪声
lines.en: I chase low, and you can hear my claws
Do not run for the thick trees

lines.zh: 我们换位置，你却被甩在后面
lines.en: We swap positions, and you fall behind
Your breathing is getting ragged
I clear half a pit in one bound
My pack is flanking from the side
The way you run has no exit

lines.zh: 我故意慢一点，让你以为能逃
lines.en: I slow a little, to let you think you can escape
My tail swings after you

lines.zh: 猎物越跑越近，因为它绕圈
lines.en: Prey gets closer when it circles

lines.zh: 你踩碎了树枝，暴露了自己
lines.en: A snapping twig gives you away

lines.zh: 我们轮流追，谁也累不着
lines.en: We take turns, and no one tires
Ten more steps and you run out of road

lines.zh: 我看见你的手在摸武器
lines.en: I see your hand reaching for a weapon
Last stretch, and I speed up
I leap, and my claws arrive first
My teeth clamp on your arm
I cut in from the side
My kick lands on your chest
I push off a trunk to gain speed
You go down under my leap
I bite and retreat, never lingering
My claws tear through cloth
My packmate leaps in next

lines.zh: 你还在站稳，我已经绕回来了
lines.en: You are still steadying yourself, and I am back
My teeth are small, the cuts are deep
That bite was aimed at your throat
Rip, then spring away

lines.zh: 我们不会给你第二次机会
lines.en: We will not give you a second chance
Grass blades still sway between my claws.
The first thing to appear is a pair of eyes
Three shadows land at once
I sniff at this new place

lines.zh: 猎手的本能比身体先醒
lines.en: The hunter's instinct wakes before my body
I shake the dirt off my feathers
My footfalls are soft, but enough
I watch you and wait for a mistake
The prey here does not know to hide
I rasp once, and my pack answers
I hug the ground, ready to bolt
One more pair of eyes, one more route
I slide out of the shadow

lines.zh: 我们不是从蛋里孵的，是从土里钻的
lines.en: We did not hatch, we clawed out of the soil
I check my retreat before advancing
My sharp toes dig into the soil

lines.zh: 这里的气味是新的，血也是
lines.en: The smell here is new, and so is the blood
Before the hunt, one second of silence
Fire singed my tail

lines.zh: 从高枝摔下来，我翻了半圈
lines.en: I drop from a high branch and tumble

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我拼命蹬腿
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I kick hard
The blast throws me far
An arrow punches through my feathers
That force knocks my footing loose
Hunger makes even my claws tremble
Lightning hits me and my feathers char
The void eats the ground and I drop
